sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. By means of this application under Section 438 Cr.P.C., the Petitioner seeks anticipatory bail apprehending his arrest on the alleged offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/294/506/34 of IPC and Sections-6 of POCSO Act and 66E/67 of IT Act in connection with Jagatsingahpur P.S. Case No. 136 of 2023 corresponding to Spl. G.R Case No. 14 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned A.D.J- Cum Spl. Judge., POCSO, Jagatsinghpur.

entities.text: A.D.J- Cum Spl. Judge., POCSO, Jagatsinghpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Having regard to the allegations in the F.I.R., there appears material in the case with regard to the offence under the POCSO Act and as such it is not desirable for this Court to grant the anticipatory bail.

However, it is directed that in the event the Petitioner surrenders and move for bail before the learned court below, the learned court in seisin over the matter shall dispose of // 2 // the bail application of the Petitioner on its own merit being alive of the position of law on bail keeping in view the gravity of the offences, as far as possible taking into consideration the materials on record as well as other documents available on record on its own merit, as far as possible on the same day if there be no other legal impediment.
The court shall apply its wisdom in allowing or rejecting the application.
4. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge B.K Sahoo Imran Khan vs State Of Odisha ....
